alt: A line graph of weekly quiz scores. The horizontal axis is Week, running from 0 to 5, and the vertical axis is Score, running from 60 to 85 and marked every 5. Four points are plotted and joined in order: Week 1 at 70, Week 2 at 75, Week 3 at 68, and Week 4 at 80. The line rises from Week 1 to Week 2, falls to its lowest point at Week 3, then rises to its highest point at Week 4.
